name: Modal
summary: Modal is a serverless compute platform for containers and GPUs, defined from Python code. Its Sandboxes product runs untrusted or LLM-generated code in isolated containers using gVisor, or a VM runtime with its own kernel for workloads that need Docker or FUSE. Sandboxes last up to 24 hours, with filesystem snapshots to carry state further.
facts: gVisor, or VM runtime with dedicated kernel
5 min default, up to 24 h; filesystem snapshots for longer
Per second; sandboxes billed at non-preemptible rates (3x list)
goodFor: Bursting to very large numbers of short-lived sandboxes
Python-first teams already deploying on Modal
watchOut: Sandbox compute costs 3x the standard list rate
Hard 24 h lifetime; long-lived state needs snapshots
